notable_finding.title: The change plan's central risk prediction was wrong, in the good direction
notable_finding.detail: change_plan.md named the get-tasks.ts hand-written column projection as the single silent-failure risk of the feature, reasoning that ProjectWithTasks is inferred from that endpoint so an omission would produce no compile error. In practice adding wipLimit there broke `pnpm typecheck` immediately at all three call sites that construct a column literal (two pre-existing web test files), forcing them to be updated. The inferred client type caught the change rather than hiding it — NFR-4 working as intended.
notable_finding.caveat: The sibling field `color` is dropped by that same projection silently only because nothing ever added it back; the mechanism is asymmetric, not absent.

outstanding: pnpm i18n:check fails — PRE-EXISTING at baseline (common:error.* missing from de-DE, a namespace this diff never touches). This run's 10 keys add to the per-locale missing list, which is an explicit non-goal. Not part of the confirmed four-command gate.
No event or activity row is written for a wipLimit mutation. Acceptable ONLY because the field is advisory; if it is ever promoted to a hard block, audit/event coverage must ship in the same change.

Benchmark hazard: the shared kaneo-mmo-itest container caused cross-arm contamination. Migration row 44 (hash 4e298c825082f0a0044c9d3c132c938485490647b9d3dab86dd804b70f430648) was the flash arm's 0043_known_night_thrasher.sql from run 20260820-123148; both arms generated an 0043 with different content, so Drizzle re-ran ADD COLUMN and 177 tests failed. Resolved by dropping the database. Future arms need their own database or a drop between arms.

apps/api/drizzle/0043_next_killraven.sql and apps/api/drizzle/meta/0043_snapshot.json were created by db:generate AFTER provenance init, so they carry no sha_before — /mmo:revert must delete them by hand. meta/_journal.json is tracked and git-restorable.
API unit tests cannot prove field forwarding (database module is stubbed); the integration tests cover it for real. Follow-up: have the stub's returning() echo the inserted row.
